Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Columbia for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Merriweather Symphony of Lights) through January 2 (Merriweather Symphony of Lights), with Yuletide at Savage Mill with Santa and Mrs. Claus (weekends from November 28) and the Bollman Truss Bridge Lighting (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
